'''Squire Kinning''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She participated in quelling the [[Arkanian Revolution]].

==Biography==
A member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Squire Kinning live on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and was taken as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by one of the Order's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]. In [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], Kinning was assigned to accompany Knight [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and Master [[Aqinos]] to [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] to assist in ending the [[Arkanian Revolution]] taking place on the world's surface.<ref name="TJP" />

While fighting against the [[Arkanian Renegades]], Kinning lost one of her [[Limb/Legends|arms]] during the conflict and was brought back to the Temple for [[Force healing/Legends|healing]]. Equipped with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic arm]], Kinning's situation was considered by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Ultimately, the Council decided to consider her loss evidence of her passing her [[Jedi Trials/Legends#Trial of the Flesh|Trial of the Flesh]], one of the five tests she would face to become a Knight. Continuing her service to the Order, she was an acquaintance of the young [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TJP" />
